title: Concept: SWIFT/BIC code served with an account reference
description: Beneficiary account plus BIC is the identifying pair behind an international transfer; together they let a fraudster pre-fill a payment order that matches the customer's real beneficiary.
applicability: International transfer receipts, beneficiary management screens and SWIFT confirmation emails rendered as HTML.
risk: A leaked pair enables convincing payment-diversion fraud against the customer and the bank.
